pairs.question: Quidnam nepoti, et filio de sacro fonte suscepto donaret?
pairs.derivation: King Amalric, having held his godson at the font, is asked what he would give him. Dropped the speech-framing 'cumque ab eo jocose quaereretur' before the question and 'respondit, sicuti homo jucundi et urbani sermonis erat:' before the answer. The question is a genuine interrogative (Quidnam) reported in indirect-discourse subjunctive but quoted as a question; the answer directly answers it. After the answer the narration continues 'Quod verbum quibusdam prudentibus...' (not part of the reply).
